name: coverage-product_cms
objective: Coverage recette for the product_cms domain: the privileged role product_admin exercises every one of its 9 catalogued actions, asserting the documented posture (9 escalate, 0 deny). Proves the catalog/engine emit the right verdict for each action of this domain.
teaching: Even the product_admin never gets a silent ALLOW on a sensitive product_cms action: governed actions escalate to a human (I6); pure-deny actions stay denied for everyone. The whole sweep is replayable for audit (I4).
